macros.name: svn
macros.doc: This macro let you typeset svn keywords directly.

macros.name: svnaftertable
macros.doc: Can hold some content to be placed after the table. By default it holds a macro to force a new page.

macros.name: svnbeforetable
macros.doc: Can hold some content to be placed between the headline and the table.

macros.name: svncgtime
macros.doc: This macros return the time part of the date only and simply return the corresponding hour, minute and second macros with a colon as separator.

macros.name: svnconsiderextensions
macros.doc: Tells svn-multi to (re-)consider the following file extension and declare files with them as extra groups if read in.

macros.name: svnexternalgroup
macros.doc: If the groups option is enabled the macro \svnexternalgroup{〈group name〉} can be used to declare a own group which is used for all the external files.

macros.name: svnfiletime
macros.doc: This macros return the time part of the date only and simply return the corresponding hour, minute and second macros with a colon as separator.

macros.name: svnFullRevision
macros.doc: Takes a revision number coming from a macro like \svnrev, \svnfilerev or a number as argument and returns the full name if it was registered first with \svnRegisterRevision, otherwise it returns “Revision 〈revision number〉”. The star version returns also the revision number leaded by ‘r’ in parentheses after the tag name, e.g. Name (r123).

macros.name: svngraphicsgroup
macros.doc: If the groups option is enabled the macro \svngraphicsgroup{〈group name〉} can be used to declare a own group which is used for all the graphic files (also for pgf images, see below).

macros.name: svngroup
macros.doc: This macro declares all following files until the next \svngroup as part of the given keyword group.

macros.name: svnignoreextensions
macros.doc: Tells svn-multi to ignore the following file extension and never declare files with them as extra groups.

macros.name: svnkwdef
macros.doc: This macro is used to define the keyword values.

macros.name: svnkwsave
macros.doc: This macro lets you include and save any keyword you like.

macros.name: svnmainfilename
macros.doc: The macro \svnmainurl and \svnmainfilename hold the URL and the filename of the main LATEXfile as long the keywords HeadURL or Id were used in it, respectively.

macros.name: svnnolinkurl
macros.doc: This macro allows you to write \svnnolinkurl{\svnkw{HeadURL}} and get the Head URL typeset verbatim.

macros.name: svnpdfdate
macros.doc: Returns the last changed date of the whole document in a format needed for \pdfinfo.

macros.name: svnRegisterAuthor
macros.doc: This macro registers 〈full name〉 as full name for 〈author〉 (a subversion username) for later use with \svnFullAuthor.

macros.name: svnRegisterRevision
macros.doc: This registers 〈tag name〉 as tag name for 〈revision number〉 for later use with \svnFullRevision.

macros.name: svnrev
macros.doc: The document global macros, like \svnrev, return the latest version control information (keyword data) for the whole multi-file document, i.e. the information of the latest changed file of the document.

macros.name: svnrevisionsname
macros.doc: Holds the name of the table of revisions which is printed above it.

macros.name: svnsetcg
macros.doc: To avoid some macro robustness problems the current group can be changed locally for the output macros using \svnsetcg{〈group name〉}.

macros.name: svnsubgroup
macros.doc: This macro declares the current file as subgroup.

macros.name: svntime
macros.doc: This macros return the time part of the date only and simply return the corresponding hour, minute and second macros with a colon as separator.

macros.name: tableofrevisions
macros.doc: If the table is enabled a table of revision is written into a file called 〈main LaTeX file〉.svt (t for table) which can be included using the \tableofrevisions macro.

macros.name: thesvncg
macros.doc: Returns the name of the current group selected by \svnsetcg.

macros.name: thesvngroup
macros.doc: Returns the name of the current keyword group.
